title: backblaze-labs references
description: Org-wide standard for recording external references about a repository — blog posts, press, docs, videos, directory/registry listings, and related projects — in a single machine-parseable file (references.yml) at the repo root. Source of truth for internal tooling (Quality Keeper validation, dashboards). Human-readable rendering is optional and not part of this contract.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bumped only for breaking changes; v1 is never mutated.

project.description: Human display name of the project (e.g. "Backblaze B2 MCP Server").

updated.description: ISO-8601 date this file was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

canonical.description: Optional canonical identity block — the "use everywhere" facts for backlinks and directory de-duplication.

package.description: Primary package coordinate, e.g. an npm or PyPI name.

backlink_anchor.description: Preferred anchor text for inbound links.

references.description: Flat list of external references. Filter by `type`/`official`/`status` rather than nesting.

id.description: Stable, unique slug for this entry within the file.

type.description: Kind of reference. Use `registry`/`listing` for directory presence, `blog`/`press` for articles, `repo`/`sample` for related code.

official.description: true if first-party (published by Backblaze); false/omitted for third-party.

published.description: ISO-8601 publication date of the referenced item, when known.

added.description: ISO-8601 date this entry was recorded.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag of the referenced item (default "en").

status.description: Link/listing health. Defaults to "live"; link-health tooling may set "dead".

canonical_for.description: Marks this entry as THE canonical one for a channel (e.g. "npm", "mcp-registry"). At most one per channel.

metrics.description: Freeform, additive metrics for this reference (e.g. { grade: "A" }, { score: 89 }).
